newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia June 1-25 palm oil exports 510,578t - SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia June 1-25 palm oil exports 510,578t - SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd on Thursday said it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for June 1-25 at 510,578 tonnes against 547,382 tonnes for May 1-25.
It said the exports comprised 102,185 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 233,013 of RBD palm olein and 65,384 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products totalled 109,996 tonnes.
China was the top buyer during the period, taking 123,850 tonnes, followed by India which bought 66,780 tonnes, Pakistan (41,200 tonnes) and South Africa (35,525 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 63,147 tonnes. -- Tan Lee Lee - Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-275-6834)
